items.title: Coherent (COHR) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Cut As Analysts Weigh AI Demand Risks
items.summary: Coherent’s modeled fair value has shifted from about US$405.22 to about US$387.80, giving investors a fresh reference point for how the market’s price targets are evolving. Recent analyst research links these changes to a balance of enthusiasm for AI driven optics and data center demand, along with a more cautious view on valuation, execution risk, and competition. As you read on, you will see how to interpret these moving targets and track the narrative around Coherent as new data comes...

items.title: Fabrinet Lost 32% in a Month. Barclays Sees 58% Upside From Here
items.summary: Key TakeawaysFabrinet shares fell 32% in the past month as AI optics stocks, including Coherent, Lumentum and Marvell, sold off on fears about AI funding and hyperscaler spending. Fabrinet had no news of its own during the sell-off.
